newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Jan-Sept fishmeal exports fall on 1995.
newsitem.headline: Chile Jan-Sept fishmeal exports fall on 1995.

text.p: Chilean fishmeal exports fell sharply in the first nine months of the year to 829,564 tonnes from 1.06 million tonnes in the same period 1995, said the fishing subsecretariat.
In terms of value, exports dropped to $482 million from $488 million in the January-September period, said officials.
Fishmeal is Chile's largest single fish export, accounting for 36 percent of total exports in the first nine months of 1996.
Overall fishing exports came to $1.3 billion in the first nine months of the year, down 3.3 percent on the same period last year.
The fall in exports was due to a 15 percent drop in export volumes, which was not made up for by a 14 percent increase in prices, said officials.
